notes.title: DEMO update
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, orc warriors! [/b]We extend our heartfelt thanks for participating in the festival demo of Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder. Your engagement, bug reports, and valuable feedback truly propel us forward as we strive for excellence in crafting this epic city-building strategy.

And now, the latest news regarding update 0.103! After listening to your feedback, we've made several significant changes that we hope will make your experiences even more epic:

[list]
[*] We've improved gameplay balance to provide more satisfying strategic experiences.
[*] We've increased the amount of available wood to facilitate the construction and development of your settlement.
[*] We've made adjustments to the consumption of leather and beer, impacting the game's economy.
[*] We've fixed an menu bug.
[*] We've implemented map navigation improvements to make movement and world exploration easier.
[*] We've resolved issues with structure collision to make building smoother and more efficient.
[/list]
We hope these changes will make your experience in the world of Orc Warchief even more satisfying. We eagerly await further feedback and suggestions from your end! Keep playing and reign as a true orc warlord!

notes.title: Steam Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. 
It’s time to “open cards” and talk a little bit about orcs.
How does the dev tribe see the orcs? Well, I’ll say so: something in between orcs from the “World of Warcraft'' and “Vikings'' from the TV-show. They are cruel, tall, and muscular as orcs, but intelligent as people. 
Orcs are strong and athletic, always ready for a fight. They are cruel sometimes but they are not mindless killing machines. Some orcs are warriors and some will be working more civil professions, bu all of them are fighter, and many of them will often be able to find trouble even in the most trivial of tasks.
It is safe to say that even in safer professions orcs will not be safe (by the way in this sentence we’ve exhausted all the budget for safety, so you will not see much more of it in the game).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/ae485b447297d53be35225fa22497ebdf324b06e.png[/img]

The main objective of the game is to ensure the prosperity and strength of your tribe. This is done by collecting enough resources of all kinds, satisfying your tribe’s needs, maintaining military might, expanding territory, gaining honor and progress.

[previewyoutube=JadaFzfaytI;full][/previewyoutube]

Tribe management is one of the central mechanics of the game. 
The player must assign orcs to appropriate jobs and ranks based on their skills, ambition, and alignment. They also have to take into account their interpersonal relationships to avoid infighting and ensure productivity. To avoid desertion and mutiny, it is similarly important to satisfy the needs of the whole tribe and make sure your underlings stay loyal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/d1bdfc76c517c9aa0c6f81a16abf6ddf219a9bb2.png[/img]

Each orc will be individual, with his/her own set of skills, finding the right orc for any given job will be your key to success.

Now you have a rough idea of our orcs. If you have questions, we will be glad to answer them in the comments.

See you soon.
Best regards,
Dev Tribe

notes.title: Steam Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
Whereas our team continues working on the Orc Warchief game, I decided to share some life hacks with you ;)
Each orc in the game has an Alignment level. It could be Merciful, Neutral or Cruel. Tribe Alignment determines the level of cruelty/mercifulness the tribe employs in its dealings and is based on the choices and policies of the Warchief. 

Tribe Alignment starts at Neutral and changes throughout the game. It’s like the mood of the tribe, which changes with every new decision of the Orc Warchief. As soon as you see props changed you will know that alignment of the tribe changed as well and you could use some special improvement for every status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/f0c8ddaf3f7156e52ada784f1b7e22f4233aba48.png[/img]

Merciful alignment effects could lower fatigue of War Parties, civilian buildings production increase, reduce conflict chances and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/2b31d02471c66410e90431bcd88538ccfeda6435.png[/img]

Cruel alignment effects could increase the morale of War Parties, reduce mutiny chances and raids could yield extra resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/d2e1f526f07b2d00908c6db211182281a5eed65d.png[/img]

Neutral alignment effects give a loyalty bonus to all alignment. It means you have fewer chances for desertion and mutiny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/7593df6869eeba9641bbed9c3b7b078eb5f89947.png[/img]

Well, these are all secrets we can open so far. Keep an eye on our devlog and you will find out much more useful info. 
What alignment are you planning to keep to? 

Best regards,
Dev Tribe

notes.title: New Orc Times - Issue #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we will be publishing the first devlog about our upcoming Orc Warchief city builder. 
We will talk about core gameplay features, how it will feel to play the game, curious facts about our orcs, our team and so on. Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and follow it not to miss our future devlogs.

Creating the game is a big process, unifying game designers, developers, 2D and 3D artists, sound designers and representatives of many other exciting professions. Today we will share with you a glimpse of how 3D assets for our game are made. 

First of all, a game designer comes up with a concept of the game. He does a huge amount of research till every puzzle of the idea comes to the right place. Then 2D Artist comes into the game and such beauty is born.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/45b5b2157626493351c65a924104ec49936fc26f.png[/img]

Then a 3D artist picks up work on this asset and adds some volume to this picture. 
Everything starts from the high poly and low poly. It’s kind of the sketch for the future model. On this model the game designer and the concept artist pay attention to the geometry, proportions, every element and give “the green colour” to the next stage - colouring and texturing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/17525af68e6f935b3c6f365ba636fc833bdc5d26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/4e1219d354452271d79d36a26f60f5cf408e0f83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/6939f49195b40fb3a06a60a4c23c0bcac9e158ac.png[/img]

So, we are on the threshold of the most exciting stage of the whole process - seeing how the idea becomes a real model. Voila! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/26429474e1c5662597da61b1748ad6fdbccefe11.gif[/img]

These are some early renders of how these models look in the engine:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/ab03117917245c073e19a06b76726c12af81b32d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/cc32681142a214028b5ba00c6aeaa63cb179e933.png[/img]

This is the pipeline for every model. The Orc Warchief Game has 400+ such models (buildings, props, clothes, weapons and others). So, this is an exciting, colourful and non-trivial journey.

notes.title: Aircraft Carrier Survival Prologue Out Today
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493800/Aircraft_Carrier_Survival_Prologue/

Aircraft Carrier Survival Prologue just OUT for free !!!

Aircraft Carrier Survival is a simulator set in World War II in which you take control of the aircraft carrier, its crew, officers, and planes as you choose the right equipment, crew, and escort for each mission.
 
In Aircraft Carrier Survival you’ll have to focus on making the best decisions to survive in a hostile environment in the middle of the ocean. Plan your missions, target your enemies and keep most of your crew safe from attacks.
 
Manage crew and officers
Assign a crew and choose what your officers should focus on. Your ship has many stations to man, and proper management will be the key to executing your plan, whether by taking on an enemy directly, sneaking past them, or taking an alternative route to completely avoid contact.
 
Damage control
Your damage control teams can handle fire outbreaks, torpedo strikes, hull flooding, enemy bombardment, airstrikes, and suicide attacks from enemy planes, but not all of them at once. Assess which threats need to be dealt with first in order to survive.
 
Survive and fight back
Use maneuvers, aircraft, anti-aircraft turrets, and whatever else you can to survive the enemy attack. Make sure that any enemy who dares to attack you will end up in the depths of the Pacific.
 
Hard decisions
Will you risk all lives on the vessel to save the one in need? Do you have what it takes to make a decision on the spot? No matter what, some sacrifices will be necessary and the only source of redemption is victory.

 
Mission planning
Use intel collected during recon missions to prepare pilots and aircraft for large operations. Target enemy land bases and even their entire fleets. Identify opponents before choosing attack directions and deciding the sequence of targets and maneuvers.

Features
Take control of an aircraft carrier in World War II.
Manage the crew, the officers, and the planes.
Choose the right equipment, crew, and escort for each mission.
Survive in a hostile environment in the middle of the ocean and fight back against your enemies.
Plan your missions, target your objectives and keep most of your crew safe from attacks.

notes.title: Live out your Warcraft classic dreams with this upcoming fantasy city builder game
notes.notes:
There seems to be a new city builder popping out of the woodwork every month at the moment, so why not kick off 2021 with another one! If it makes you feel any better, this latest announcement will let you live out your 'OG' Warcraft dream in a fantasy 'Orcs vs. Humans' setting. Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder is a, well, strategic city building game where you lead a band of orcs who've been driven out of their homelands by the pesky human masses.

Thirsty for revenge, and having played a cracking RTS game back in the day called Warcraft 2, you must rally your fellow Orc-rads and collect the resources you'll need to rebuild your society, before raising an army to take the fight back to the humans.

In the words of the game's own Steam page: "Mine metal and forge weapons necessary for your army. Train your warriors and equip them with various armour and gear. Build defences to buy time for preparations and strike when you're ready for war."

Read the rest of the story...
